$comment: Schema version: v1. Project documents declare it via schemaVersion. Canonical form: project.schema.yaml; project.schema.json is derived from it.
title: RepoForge Project Model
description: Structured project definition consumed by orchestration and MCP tooling. Unknown fields are rejected: every object sets additionalProperties to false. The name doubles as a filesystem identifier, so its pattern excludes separators, dots, and uppercase (spec.md FR-031).

schemaVersion.description: Project model schema version. Tooling must reject documents declaring an unknown version (spec.md FR-031).

name.description: Project name. Lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens only: the name may seed output directories, so path separators, dots, and traversal sequences are impossible by construction.

purpose.description: What the project is for, in plain language. Must be non-blank.

users.description: Intended users of the project. Optional; every entry must be non-blank.

id.description: Stable requirement identifier (for example FR-001). Identifiers must be unique within the document.

text.description: The requirement, in plain language. Must be non-blank.

requirements.description: Functional scope of the project. Optional; semantic uniqueness of identifiers is enforced by tooling.

exclusions.description: Explicit non-goals. Optional; every entry must be non-blank.
